{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# DCOL training pipeline: data loading -> training -> evaluation -> checkpoint
#
# Usage:
#   bash scripts/run_dcol_training.sh                          # defaults
#   bash scripts/run_dcol_training.sh --gpu 1 --dry_run        # dry run on GPU 1
#   bash scripts/run_dcol_training.sh --batch_size 64 --epochs 15

set -euo pipefail

# ----- Defaults (override via CLI) -----
GPU="${GPU:-0}"
DATA_DIR="${DATA_DIR:-data/}"
OUTPUT_DIR="${OUTPUT_DIR:-checkpoints/dcol/}"
LOG_DIR="${LOG_DIR:-logs/}"
MODEL_PATH="${MODEL_PATH:-/root/autodl-tmp/models/deberta-v3-large}"
FEATURES_PATH="${FEATURES_PATH:-data/features_all.jsonl}"
BATCH_SIZE="${BATCH_SIZE:-32}"
EPOCHS="${EPOCHS:-10}"
LR="${LR:-2e-5}"
MARGIN_LR="${MARGIN_LR:-1e-3}"
CL_WEIGHT="${CL_WEIGHT:-0.5}"
MAX_LENGTH="${MAX_LENGTH:-512}"
SEED="${SEED:-42}"
DRY_RUN=""
EXTRA_ARGS=""

# Parse command-line overrides
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
        --gpu)         GPU="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --data_dir)    DATA_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --output_dir)  OUTPUT_DIR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --model_path)  MODEL_PATH="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --batch_size)  BATCH_SIZE="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --epochs)      EPOCHS="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --lr)          LR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --margin_lr)   MARGIN_LR="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --seed)        SEED="$2"; shift 2 ;;
        --dry_run)     DRY_RUN="--dry_run"; shift ;;
        *)             EXTRA_ARGS="$EXTRA_ARGS $1"; shift ;;
    esac
done

# ----- Environment -----
PROJ_ROOT="$(cd "$(dirname "$0")/.." && pwd)"
cd "$PROJ_ROOT"

# Conda activation (AutoDL aml-train image)
if [ -f /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh ]; then
    source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
    conda activate base
fi

export CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES="$GPU"
export HF_HOME="/root/autodl-tmp/.hf_cache"

# ----- Directories -----
mkdir -p "$OUTPUT_DIR" "$LOG_DIR"

# ----- Check model availability -----
if [ ! -d "$MODEL_PATH" ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Model not found at $MODEL_PATH"
    echo "[INFO] Will download from HuggingFace (microsoft/deberta-v3-large)"
    # Enable network acceleration on AutoDL
    if [ -f /etc/network_turbo ]; then
        source /etc/network_turbo
        export REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
        export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
    fi
    MODEL_PATH="microsoft/deberta-v3-large"
fi

# ----- Check features -----
FEAT_FLAG=""
if [ -f "$FEATURES_PATH" ]; then
    echo "[INFO] Using pre-computed features: $FEATURES_PATH"
    FEAT_FLAG="--features_path $FEATURES_PATH"
fi

# ----- Run training -----
echo "============================================"
echo " DCOL Training Pipeline"
echo " GPU:         $GPU"
echo " Data:        $DATA_DIR"
echo " Model:       $MODEL_PATH"
echo " Batch size:  $BATCH_SIZE"
echo " Epochs:      $EPOCHS"
echo " LR:          $LR (margin: $MARGIN_LR)"
echo " CL weight:   $CL_WEIGHT"
echo " Output:      $OUTPUT_DIR"
echo " Dry run:     ${DRY_RUN:-no}"
echo "============================================"

python src/dcol_trainer.py \
    --data_dir "$DATA_DIR" \
    --model_path "$MODEL_PATH" \
    --output_dir "$OUTPUT_DIR" \
    --log_dir "$LOG_DIR" \
    --batch_size "$BATCH_SIZE" \
    --epochs "$EPOCHS" \
    --lr "$LR" \
    --margin_lr "$MARGIN_LR" \
    --cl_weight "$CL_WEIGHT" \
    --max_length "$MAX_LENGTH" \
    --gpu 0 \
    --seed "$SEED" \
    $FEAT_FLAG \
    $DRY_RUN \
    $EXTRA_ARGS

TRAIN_EXIT=$?
if [ $TRAIN_EXIT -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "[ERROR] Training failed with exit code $TRAIN_EXIT"
    exit $TRAIN_EXIT
fi

# ----- Run evaluation (skip for dry run) -----
if [ -z "$DRY_RUN" ] && [ -f "$OUTPUT_DIR/best_model.pt" ]; then
    echo ""
    echo "============================================"
    echo " Running evaluation..."
    echo "============================================"

    python src/dcol_eval.py \
        --checkpoint "$OUTPUT_DIR/best_model.pt" \
        --data_dir "$DATA_DIR" \
        --output_dir "results/dcol/" \
        --gpu 0 \
        --eval_mode all \
        $FEAT_FLAG

    echo ""
    echo "[DONE] Training + evaluation complete."
    echo "  Checkpoint: $OUTPUT_DIR/best_model.pt"
    echo "  Results:    results/dcol/dcol_eval_results.json"
else
    echo ""
    echo "[DONE] Training complete."
    echo "  Checkpoint: $OUTPUT_DIR/"
